### Encountering Modern Day Simon the Sorcerers
Author: Vivian Bricker
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/encountering-modern-day-simon-the-sorcerers-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Acts 8:18-23
Points:
- Simon was drawn to spiritual power and sought to purchase the authority to bestow the Holy Spirit.
- Peter recognized Simon's internal corruption, captivity to sin, and improper motives, firmly rebuking him.
- Modern leaders and teachers can exhibit the same self-serving, manipulative traits as Simon the Sorcerer.
- Believers must cultivate spiritual discernment to distinguish true servants of Christ from deceptive individuals seeking worldly gain.
- Those who misuse the gospel or deny the Lord through their conduct should be confronted and called to repentance.

### Lust for Power
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lust-for-power
Passage: Acts 8:18-19
Points:
- Simon viewed the outpouring of the Holy Spirit as a magical ability he could purchase for personal prestige.
- His attempt to buy God's spiritual gifts revealed that his heart was unregenerate and corrupted by an appetite for power.
- Peter confronted Simon's wickedness with spiritual discernment while urging him to repent and seek the Lord's forgiveness.
- Simon's fearful response mirrored worldly dread rather than genuine repentance.
- Spiritual gifts are distributed by the Holy Spirit to build up the church in love, not for self-magnification.
